# cr-ci deploy-mediator.sh (dry-run) project=example-project region=us-central1
# dry-run: nothing is changed; '?' lines are read-only checks, assumed to find nothing
# check: which runner image the job runs (upgrade order: the mediator first, then deploy-job.sh)
? gcloud run jobs describe cr-gh-runner-8c32g --region=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(metadata.name)'
# mediator image cr-runner-mediator:golden
? gcloud artifacts docker images describe us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/example-project/cr-runners/cr-runner-mediator:golden --project=example-project '--format=value(image_summary.digest)'
+ gcloud builds submit . --config=scripts/cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions=_IMAGE=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/example-project/cr-runners/cr-runner-mediator:golden,_DOCKERFILE=mediator/Dockerfile --gcs-source-staging-dir=gs://example-project-cr-ci-staging/source --service-account=projects/example-project/serviceAccounts/cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --region=us-central1 --project=example-project
# C12: mediator service cr-runner-mediator (max-instances=1 is required: claims live in memory)
+ gcloud run deploy cr-runner-mediator --image=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/example-project/cr-runners/cr-runner-mediator:golden --region=us-central1 --project=example-project --service-account=cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --min-instances=0 --max-instances=1 --cpu=1 --memory=512Mi --concurrency=80 --timeout=300 --ingress=all --port=8080 --no-allow-unauthenticated --no-invoker-iam-check '--set-env-vars=^;^TARGET_REPOS=example-owner/example-repo,example-owner/other-repo;GITHUB_APP_ID=123456;GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_SCOPE=repo;GCP_PROJECT=example-project;REGION=us-central1;RUNNER_LABEL=scion-cr-8c32g;CLAIM_TTL=300s;RUNNER_JOB_NAME=cr-gh-runner-8c32g;RUNNER_IMAGE_NAME=gh-runner;MEDIATOR_IMAGE_NAME=cr-runner-mediator;RUNNER_CPU=8;RUNNER_MEMORY=32Gi;RUNNER_DISK_GI=10;MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNNERS=5;RUNNER_BUILD_CACHE_IN_RAM=false;TASK_TIMEOUT=45m;RUNNER_IDLE_TIMEOUT=10m;ARTIFACT_REPO=cr-runners;BUILD_STAGING_BUCKET=;MEDIATOR_SERVICE_NAME=cr-runner-mediator;MEDIATOR_MIN_INSTANCES=0;RECONCILER_JOB_NAME=cr-runner-reconciler;RECONCILE_SCHEDULE=*/5 * * * *;MEDIATOR_URL=https://cr-runner-mediator-abc123-uc.a.run.app;GITHUB_RUNNER_GROUP_ID=1;ROUTING_VARIABLE_NAME=SCION_LARGE_RUNNER;BUILD_SA_NAME=cr-runner-build-sa;MEDIATOR_SA_NAME=cr-runner-mediator-sa;SCHEDULER_SA_NAME=cr-runner-scheduler-sa;EXEC_SA_NAME=cr-runner-exec-sa;GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_SECRET_NAME=cr-runner-gh-app-private-key;GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_NAME=cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret' --labels=managed-by=cr-ci
# check: max-instances is 1
? gcloud run services describe cr-runner-mediator --region=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(spec.template.metadata.annotations."autoscaling.knative.dev/maxScale")'
# C13: SCHEDULER_SA_NAME may invoke this service only
+ gcloud run services add-iam-policy-binding cr-runner-mediator --region=us-central1 --project=example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-scheduler-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/run.invoker --format=none
? gcloud run services describe cr-runner-mediator --region=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(status.url)'
# service URL: <url printed by the command above>
? gcloud run services describe cr-runner-mediator --region=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(metadata.annotations."run.googleapis.com/urls")'
